# Debt payoff planner

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/debt-payoff/

Model fixed-rate debts with minimum payments and an extra monthly budget using smallest-balance or highest-rate priority.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Compare two debts using the same total payment budget and review modeled months and interest.

## Limits and checks

The model uses monthly APR/12 interest, end-of-month payments and no fees or new borrowing. Real lender calculations can differ; unaffordable or non-reducing plans are flagged.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
